withdrawal_terms: Withdrawal is also permitted at any time after 3/17/2026 to the extent the tendered Common Units have not yet been accepted for purchase
settlement_terms: Acceptance: the Fund is deemed to have accepted and repurchased tendered Common Units when it gives written notice of its election to repurchase them | Immediately after the Expiration Date, each holder whose Common Units have been accepted will be issued a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable and non-negotiable Repurchase Instrument | Payment: following determination of NAV as of March 31, 2026, no later than the later of 30 days after that date or, if the Fund requests Sub-Fund withdrawals to fund repurchases, within 10 business days after receiving at least 90% of the aggregate amount withdrawn | The Repurchase Instrument may be prepaid on or after the Valuation Date without premium, penalty or notice | Payment generally in cash, with a limited possibility of an in-kind distribution of securities

tendering_conditions: All Unitholders may tender | Minimum tender is Common Units worth $20,000 based on the last NAV calculation before expiration; holders with less than $20,000 must tender their entire investment, and a partial tender leaving a capital account balance below $20,000 is deemed a tender of all Common Units | A completed and executed Letter of Transmittal must be emailed to 50southsubdocs@50southcapital.ntrs.com by 2/17/2026 5:00 PM Central time | Joint holders must all sign; representatives must provide evidence of authority when required, and certain payment instructions require a signature guarantee | The Fund may reject tenders in inappropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful; defects must be cured within the period the Fund determines unless waived

default_option: A partial tender that would reduce a Unitholder’s capital account balance below $20,000 is deemed a tender of all of that Unitholder’s Common Units
financial_terms: Up to a number of Common Units having aggregate NAV of $45,000,000 as of the last NAV calculation before expiration | Expected payment sources: cash on hand, withdrawals of capital from Sub-Funds, and/or borrowings | The Fund may finance part of the purchase price through borrowings; borrowing under its Bank of Montreal credit agreement may not exceed 10% of Fund NAV
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance if it cannot liquidate portfolio securities orderly and consistently with its investment objectives and policies; if the Board judges that specified legal proceedings, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspensions, calamities, a material NAV decrease or another materially adverse event exists; or if the Board determines purchasing Common Units is not in the Fund’s best interests | These conditions are for the Fund’s sole benefit and may be waived in whole or in part by the Fund before the payment date | The Fund may extend the Offer by notifying Unitholders and may adjust the Valuation Date if extended | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, in jurisdictions where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable securities or Blue Sky laws

security_description: First Eagle Private Credit Fund Class I common shares of beneficial interest and Class D common shares of beneficial interest; par value $0.01
event_status_details: The Offer began on January 30, 2026 and was scheduled to expire on February 27, 2026 unless extended
offer_price: Net asset value per Share as of March 31, 2026 or a later date determined by the Fund if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Class I common share or Class D common share of beneficial interest
offer_price_qualifications: A 2% early repurchase deduction reduces proceeds for Shares repurchased with a Valuation Date within 12 months after their original issue date, subject to stated exceptions and possible non-application to certain feeder vehicles | Payment is made through a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note
withdrawal_terms: If the Fund has not accepted the tendered Shares, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 3/31/2026
settlement_terms: Acceptance occurs when the Fund gives written notice to the tendering Shareholder of its election to purchase | Payment is effected through a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note held by the Transfer Agent | Unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay, payment under the Note will be made on or before 30 days after the Valuation Date
proration_terms: If more than 622888 Shares are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund will accept Shares tendered by the Expiration Date on a pro rata basis based on the number tendered, subject to the requirements and exemptions of Rule 13e-4 | The Fund reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of its outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must complete and sign the Letter of Transmittal, which must be received by the specified agent by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the Expiration Date | Depending on the Letter of Transmittal instructions, submit it to SS&C GIDS, Inc. by regular mail, overnight mail or fax, or to the Shareholder’s financial advisor | A Shareholder who faxes the Letter of Transmittal must promptly mail the original | For a partial tender, the Shareholder must maintain a minimum account balance of $500 as of the Valuation Date, subject to the Fund’s stated rights to waive the minimum, reduce the repurchase or purchase all Shares | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful, and may waive conditions or defects
available_options: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares | If a repurchase request would be reduced on a pro rata basis, a Shareholder may elect either pro rata processing or withdrawal of the entire request | For a partial repurchase that would breach the minimum account balance, a Shareholder may elect to change the request to a full repurchase
default_option: If no pro rata processing option is selected, the repurchase request will be processed on a pro rata basis if needed | If no cost-basis method is selected, FIFO applies | If no payment option is selected, a check will be sent to the address of record, subject to stated automatic payment to custodians or broker-dealers for certain accounts
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 622888 Shares, approximately 5% of Shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025 | The purchase price is expected to be funded from cash on hand, borrowings and/or proceeds from sales of portfolio holdings | The Fund does not expect to impose charges on repurchases other than any applicable early repurchase deduction
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date, or amend, cancel or postpone acceptance | The Fund may cancel, amend or postpone if it cannot liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with its objectives and policies; if the Board judges that specified legal, banking, credit, market, war or other material adverse events exist; or if the Independent Trustees determine that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund may waive Offer conditions or tender defects | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, in a jurisdiction where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable securities or Blue Sky laws

security_description: Blackstone Private Credit Fund Class I, Class S and Class D common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01
event_status_details: The tender offer period began February 2, 2026
offer_price: Net asset value per Share as of March 31, 2026 or a later date determined by the Fund if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Class I, Class S or Class D common share of beneficial interest
offer_price_qualifications: A 2% early repurchase deduction reduces proceeds for Shares with a tender valuation date within 12 months following their original issue date, except in the case of death, divorce or qualified disability of a Shareholder and certain discretionary model portfolio management programs | Other than any applicable early repurchase deduction, the Fund does not expect to impose charges on repurchases
withdrawal_terms: If the Fund has not accepted the tendered Shares, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 3/31/2026
settlement_terms: Acceptance occurs when the Fund gives written notice to the tendering Shareholder of its election to purchase | Payment is effected through a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note held by the Transfer Agent | The note provides for payment in a single installment on or before 30 days after the Valuation Date, unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay
proration_terms: If more than 96013428 Shares are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, Shares will be accepted on a pro rata basis based on the number tendered, with priority for repurchase requests in the case of a shareholder’s death, disability or divorce | The Fund reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of its outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer | Unaccepted Shares are not automatically carried forward or given priority in a future offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must complete and sign the Letter of Transmittal and submit it as instructed to SS&C GIDS, Inc. or their financial advisor, as applicable, so it is received by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on 3/2/2026 | Transfer Agent submissions may be mailed to P.O. Box 219270, Kansas City, MO 64121, sent by overnight mail to 801 Pennsylvania Avenue, Suite 219270, Kansas City, MO 64105-1307, or faxed to (816) 256-8862; a faxed original must be mailed promptly afterward | Shareholders may tender all or part of their Shares; a partial tender must leave a minimum account balance of $500 as of the Valuation Date, subject to the Fund’s stated rights to purchase all Shares, reduce the repurchase amount or waive the minimum | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful, and may waive conditions or tender defects
available_options: Tender all or a portion of Shares | If a partial repurchase would put the account below the required minimum balance, elect to change the request to a full repurchase rather than have the amount reduced | If a request would be reduced on a pro rata basis, elect to have it processed pro rata or withdraw the entire request
default_option: If no pro-rata treatment option is selected, the repurchase request will be processed on a pro-rata basis, if needed
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 96013428 Shares, approximately 5% of Shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025 | Purchase proceeds are expected to come from cash on hand, borrowings and/or proceeds from sales of portfolio holdings | No person has been employed, retained or is to be compensated by the Fund to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the Offer to Purchase
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the offer and adjust the Valuation Date, amend or cancel the offer, or postpone acceptance | The stated grounds for cancellation, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal actions, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspensions, calamities, a material decrease in estimated net asset value or other material adverse events; or a determination by the Independent Trustees that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund reserves the right to exclude Shareholders in a jurisdiction where it is asserted that the Offer cannot lawfully be made
related_entities: Blackstone BDC Holdings LLC (affiliate of the Advisers)

event_status_details: Yext announced commencement of a modified Dutch auction tender offer to purchase up to $180 million in value of its common stock.
offer_price_basis: per share of common stock
offer_price_qualifications: Single purchase price determined through a modified Dutch auction | All purchased shares receive the same price, even if tendered at a lower price | Cash, less applicable withholding taxes and without interest
withdrawal_terms: If tendered Shares have not been accepted for payment, withdrawal is also permitted after 4/7/2026 12:00 midnight New York City time | If the Offer is extended, withdrawal is permitted until the extended Expiration Time
settlement_terms: Purchase Price determined promptly following the Expiration Time | Acceptance and payment promptly after the Expiration Time, subject to the Offer’s terms and conditions | Payment made by depositing the aggregate purchase price with the Depositary, which transmits payment to tendering stockholders | Final proration results and payment are not expected until after the guaranteed delivery period | No interest paid, including for payment delays
proration_terms: If more than $180 million in value of Shares are validly tendered at or below the Purchase Price and not withdrawn, purchase first from eligible holders of fewer than 100 Shares who tender all their Shares; second, purchase other eligible Shares pro rata, with adjustments to avoid fractional Shares; third, if needed to purchase $180 million in value of Shares, select conditional tenders whose conditions were not initially satisfied by random lot, to the extent feasible, if those holders tendered all their Shares | The Company may purchase up to an additional 2% of outstanding Shares without extending the Offer
tendering_conditions: Shares must be tendered before the Expiration Time at the Purchase Price determined under the Offer or at one specified price within the offered range; only Shares tendered at or below the Purchase Price and not withdrawn are eligible for purchase | Registered holders must deliver a properly completed and signed Letter of Transmittal, required signature guarantees and other required documents to the Depositary; book-entry tenders require timely confirmation of transfer into the Depositary’s account and an agent’s message | Holders through nominees must instruct their nominee, which may set an earlier deadline | A holder tendering at multiple prices must use separate Letters of Transmittal or book-entry transfers, and the same Shares cannot be tendered at multiple prices unless withdrawn first | Odd-lot priority requires an eligible holder to tender all Shares and complete the Odd Lots section | Conditional tenders must specify the minimum number of Shares to be purchased; a tender not meeting that minimum is treated as withdrawn unless selected by random lot | Holders unable to deliver required documents or complete book-entry transfer on time may use guaranteed delivery through an eligible institution; the Notice of Guaranteed Delivery must arrive before expiration and the remaining required materials by 5:00 PM New York City time one trading day after its execution and delivery | Vested options must be exercised before the resulting Shares can be tendered; Shares underlying RSUs or PSUs may be tendered only after vesting and receipt free of transfer restrictions | Defective tenders are not valid until defects are cured or waived
available_options: Tender all or part of Shares | Accept the Purchase Price determined under the Offer or specify a tender price within the $5.75 to $6.50 range using the listed price choices | Tender different portions at different prices using separate submissions | Condition a tender on purchase of a specified minimum number of Shares | Eligible holders of fewer than 100 Shares may tender all their Shares for odd-lot priority | Stockholders may choose not to participate
default_option: If a holder elects to accept the Purchase Price determined under the Offer, Shares are initially deemed tendered at $5.75 per Share | If more than one price box or no price box is checked, there is no valid tender | A tender is unconditional unless the Conditional Tender box is completed | On the nominee instruction form, all Shares held for the holder’s account are assumed tendered unless another number is specified
financial_terms: Up to $180 million in value of Shares; 27692307 Shares at the maximum Purchase Price or 31304347 Shares at the minimum Purchase Price if fully subscribed | The Company may increase Shares accepted for payment by no more than 2% of outstanding Shares without extending the Offer | Expected aggregate cost, including fees and expenses, is approximately $182.3 million if fully subscribed | Funding expected from cash on hand and borrowings under existing credit facilities | Dealer Manager, Information Agent and Depositary receive reasonable and customary compensation and expense reimbursement
conditions_restrictions: No financing condition | Conditions include specified legal or governmental proceedings and restraints; adverse political, market, economic or financial changes; specified share-price or market-index declines; adverse tax legislation; competing transactions or specified changes in beneficial ownership; adverse laws or regulatory actions; material adverse changes affecting Yext or its subsidiaries; and a determination that the Offer may cause NYSE delisting, Exchange Act deregistration or beneficial ownership by fewer than 300 persons | The Company may waive conditions in whole or in part before the Expiration Time, subject to applicable law, or terminate, extend or delay acceptance or payment if conditions are not satisfied | The Company may extend or amend the Offer, including its price range or aggregate value sought, subject to applicable law and required extensions | The Offer will not be made to, and tenders will not be accepted from or on behalf of, holders in jurisdictions where compliance cannot be achieved after a good-faith effort

security_description: CyberArk Software Ltd.’s 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due June 15, 2030
event_status_details: Palo Alto Networks offered to repurchase any and all outstanding Notes following the February 11, 2026 merger, which constituted a Fundamental Change.
offer_price_basis: per $1000.00 principal amount of CyberArk Software Ltd.’s 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030
offer_price_qualifications: 100% of principal plus any accrued and unpaid Special Interest to, but excluding, the Fundamental Change Repurchase Date | No Special Interest is currently due or expected to accrue before that date
settlement_terms: Acceptance: promptly upon expiration of the Repurchase Right | PANW will deposit sufficient funds with the Paying Agent on or prior to 11:00 AM New York City time on March 24, 2026 | The Paying Agent will pay DTC following the later of the Fundamental Change Repurchase Date and book-entry transfer of accepted Notes; DTC will distribute funds to its participants
tendering_conditions: Only registered Holders may surrender Notes | Tender through DTC’s Automated Tender Offer Program; holders using a nominee must instruct the nominee to tender on their behalf | DTC participants must deliver their beneficial interest to the Paying Agent’s DTC account and electronically transmit acceptance through ATOP before 3/20/2026 5:00 PM New York City time | Partial tenders must be in $100000.00 principal amount or integral multiples of $100000.00 above that amount, or such lesser amount held by a Holder | If required under the Indenture, pay funds equal to Special Interest payable on the next Special Interest payment date to which the Holder is not entitled | Late tenders are invalid
available_options: Tender all or part of the Notes for cash at $1000.00 per $1000.00 principal amount, subject to the $100000.00 denomination requirement or such lesser amount held by a Holder | Convert all or an eligible portion of the Notes during the Make-Whole Fundamental Change Period at 2.5308 units of Reference Property per $1000.00 principal amount, with conversion settled in cash | Retain the Notes through maturity
default_option: If a Holder does not tender or exercise the Make-Whole Conversion Right before expiration, the Notes will not be repurchased or converted and will remain outstanding under the existing terms of the Indenture and Notes.
financial_terms: Offer for any and all outstanding Notes | $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount outstanding | $1.25 billion required if all Notes are validly surrendered and accepted | Cash on hand will be used | No commission payable to PANW, CyberArk, DTC or the Paying Agent for exercising the Repurchase Right; broker commissions may apply
conditions_restrictions: Repurchase is subject only to being lawful and satisfaction of the stated procedural requirements | No financing condition | PANW may extend the expiration date as provided in the Offer to Purchase, but does not intend to extend the exercise period unless required by applicable law, regulation or rule
related_entities: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. (parent) | Athens Strategies Ltd. (merger subsidiary)

offer_price: Not less than NAV Per Share next calculated following the Expiration Date and not more than 2.5% greater than that NAV Per Share, plus any unpaid dividends accrued through the Expiration Date
offer_price_basis: per share of common stock
offer_price_qualifications: Less any applicable withholding taxes | Without interest
withdrawal_terms: Unless already accepted for payment, tendered Shares may be withdrawn any time prior to 40 business days following the Expiration Date
settlement_terms: Acceptance and cash payment: promptly after the Expiration Date for validly tendered and not withdrawn Shares | Payment: deposit of the aggregate purchase price with the Depositary, which transmits payment to tendering Shareholders | Payment requires timely receipt of a properly completed and duly executed Letter of Transmittal | The Company may delay acceptance or payment to comply with applicable law
proration_terms: If repurchase requests exceed the number of Shares the Company seeks to repurchase, Shares will be repurchased on a pro-rata basis, up to 1% or 84,095.835 Shares
tendering_conditions: Open to all Shareholders | A properly completed and duly executed Letter of Transmittal bearing original signatures and any other required documents must be physically received by the Tender Agent before 4:00 PM New York City time on the Expiration Date, by mail, courier or personal delivery | Holders whose Shares are registered with a broker or other nominee must contact that holder; nominee approval and signature are required | Partial tenders must leave a minimum balance of $2,500 worth of common stock | The Company may reject improper tenders or waive defects | A Notice of Guaranteed Delivery received by the Expiration Date may be used when Shares or required documents cannot be delivered by then; the eligible institution guarantees delivery of the Shares, Letter of Transmittal or book-entry Agent’s Message, and other required documents within three New York Stock Exchange trading days
available_options: Tender all or a portion of Shares; a partial tender must leave a minimum balance of $2,500 worth of common stock
default_option: Unless otherwise indicated on the Letter of Transmittal, all Shares are assumed to be tendered
financial_terms: Purchase limit: up to 1% or 84,095.835 outstanding Shares | Estimated total cost at the January 31, 2026 NAV Per Share, excluding offer fees and expenses: approximately $372544.55, plus any unpaid dividends accrued through the Expiration Date | Funding: proceeds from common stock sold under the distribution reinvestment plan; at the Board’s sole discretion, cash on hand, borrowings or cash from liquidated investments may also be used | The Company pays reasonable and customary Tender Agent compensation and certain expenses, and bears printing and mailing costs, SEC filing fees and legal fees | Tendering holders pay no brokerage fees or commissions to tender directly, but a broker or nominee may charge them a fee
conditions_restrictions: No financing condition | Unless otherwise determined by the Board, the Company cannot accept tenders or repurchase Shares if doing so would impair regulated investment company eligibility or cause failure to comply with applicable asset coverage requirements; specified proceedings, restraints or adverse actions arise; or specified securities-market, banking or credit disruptions occur | The conditions are for the Company’s sole benefit and may be waived by the Company, in whole or in part, on or before the Expiration Date | The Company may terminate, extend or amend the Offer during its pendency | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, in jurisdictions where doing so would not comply with applicable law

offer_price_basis: per share of common stock
offer_price_qualifications: Cash, without interest and less any required withholding taxes
withdrawal_terms: If Shares have not been accepted for payment, withdrawal is also permitted after 7/11/2026 | No withdrawal rights apply to Shares tendered in a Subsequent Offering Period or to Shares previously tendered and accepted for payment
settlement_terms: Acceptance and payment: promptly after the Expiration Time, subject to the Offer's conditions | Payment: deposit of the purchase price with the Depositary, which transmits payments to stockholders | Payment requires timely receipt of Shares and required documents | No interest is paid | If a Subsequent Offering Period is provided, Shares tendered during it will be immediately accepted and promptly paid for
minimum_tender_condition: Validly tendered and not validly withdrawn Shares, excluding Shares tendered through guaranteed delivery procedures that have not yet been received, when added to Shares then owned by the Purchaser, must represent one share more than one half of all Shares outstanding at the Expiration Time | The Purchaser states that it may waive conditions to the Offer, including the Minimum Tender Condition

available_options: Holders may tender all or a portion of their Shares

proration_terms: If properly tendered and unwithdrawn shares exceed the $25,000,000 aggregate purchase amount, purchase first all qualifying odd lots of fewer than 100 shares tendered in full at or below the purchase price | Purchase other qualifying shares pro rata, with adjustments to avoid fractional shares and subject to conditional tender provisions | If necessary to reach the purchase amount, select qualifying conditional tenders by random lot, to the extent feasible, from holders who tendered all their shares | The Company reserves the right to purchase up to an additional 2% of outstanding Class A shares without extending the offer
tendering_conditions: Class A common stock must be properly tendered and not properly withdrawn before expiration | A holder must select one tender price in $0.02 increments or elect the purchase price determined by the Company; separate letters are required to tender different shares at different prices | Submit share certificates or book-entry confirmation, a properly completed and signed Letter of Transmittal with any required signature guarantees or an Agent's Message for book-entry delivery, and other required documents to the depositary by expiration | Alternatively, use the guaranteed delivery procedure through an Eligible Institution, with a Notice of Guaranteed Delivery received by expiration and the remaining required shares and documents delivered within one Nasdaq trading day after execution of the notice | Holders using a broker or other nominee must instruct that nominee; Shareworks holders must have instructions received by 5:00 p.m. New York City time on June 8, 2026, unless extended | Qualifying odd-lot holders must tender all their shares and complete the odd-lot section | Conditional tenders must specify the minimum number of shares to be purchased; defects must be cured or waived for a tender to be proper
available_options: Tender all or part of Class A shares, or choose not to participate | Specify a tender price from $0.98 to $1.20 per share in $0.02 increments, or elect the purchase price determined by the Company | Condition a tender on purchase of a specified minimum number of tendered shares | Qualifying holders of fewer than 100 shares may tender all their shares for odd-lot priority
default_option: If more than one price box or no price box is checked, the shares are not properly tendered | A tender without a specified conditional minimum is unconditional | If a Shareworks holder does not properly return instructions by the applicable deadline, those shares will not be tendered
financial_terms: Purchase of shares for an aggregate price of up to $25,000,000, or a lower amount depending on valid tenders | If fully subscribed, purchase of 25,510,204 shares at the minimum price or 20,833,333 shares at the maximum price, representing approximately 30% or 25%, respectively, of Class A shares outstanding as of May 4, 2026 | The Company may purchase up to an additional 2% of outstanding Class A shares without extending the offer | Funded with cash on hand | Expected aggregate cost, including fees and expenses, of approximately $26.0 million if fully subscribed without the additional 2% purchase | Dealer manager, information agent and depositary receive reasonable and customary compensation and reimbursement of specified expenses
conditions_restrictions: No financing condition | Subject to conditions concerning legal proceedings or restraints, adverse effects on the Company's business, market or banking disruptions, war or other calamities, a decrease of more than 10% in specified market prices or indexes, competing transactions or ownership changes, and continued Nasdaq listing and Exchange Act registration | Conditions are for the Company's sole benefit and may be waived by it in whole or in part before expiration | The Company may extend, amend, delay acceptance or payment, or terminate the offer subject to applicable law | The offer will not be made in a U.S. state where it cannot be made in compliance with applicable law after a good-faith effort

default_option: If the number of Shares tendered is not indicated for certificates or book-entry Shares delivered to the Depositary, all Shares represented will be deemed tendered

withdrawal_terms: After expiration, holders may withdraw tendered Depositary Shares not accepted for purchase within forty business days from commencement of the Offers
settlement_terms: Acceptance: on the Settlement Date, subject to the offer terms and conditions; the Company is deemed to have accepted Depositary Shares only when it gives written notice to the Tender Agent | Payment: promptly after expiration; the expected Settlement Date is 9/10/2026 | Payment is deposited with DTC for transmission to tendering holders

tendering_conditions: All Depositary Shares are held in book-entry form through DTC and must be tendered through DTC before expiration | A DTC participant must transmit acceptance through ATOP, producing an agent’s message, or deliver a properly completed and duly executed Letter of Transmittal to the Tender Agent | The Tender Agent must receive the agent’s message or Letter of Transmittal and confirmation of book-entry transfer into its DTC account | Beneficial owners holding through a Custodian must instruct it to tender; it may impose an earlier deadline or charge a fee | Series D Depositary Shares may be tendered only in whole shares, with a minimum Liquidation Preference of $25.00 and integral multiples above that amount | No alternative, conditional or contingent tenders are accepted; no guaranteed delivery procedures are available | Defective tenders are not properly made until defects are cured or waived by the Company
available_options: Holders may tender all or part of their Series D Depositary Shares in whole-share increments
default_option: If a tendering holder does not specify the number of Series D Depositary Shares tendered, the entire number indicated as represented is deemed tendered
financial_terms: The Company will purchase up to $500000000 in aggregate Liquidation Preference across the two Offers | 20000000 Series D Depositary Shares, representing $500000000 in aggregate Liquidation Preference, were outstanding | Consideration, Accrued Dividends, fees and expenses will be paid with cash on hand | Dealer Managers, the Information Agent and the Tender Agent receive reasonable and customary compensation and reimbursement of specified reasonable out-of-pocket expenses | Eligible Retail Processing Dealers receive $0.025 per $25.00 Liquidation Preference of purchased Series D Depositary Shares tendered for retail beneficial owners who tender no more than 10000 Series D Depositary Shares
conditions_restrictions: The Company's obligation to purchase Series D Depositary Shares is subject to the Continued Listing Condition: the Company must determine there is no reasonable likelihood the purchase will cause their NYSE delisting or eligibility for Exchange Act deregistration | Other General Conditions include no legal or regulatory action restraining or adversely affecting the Offer; no material adverse change affecting the Company and its subsidiaries; and no specified market, banking, war, credit or interest-rate event | The conditions are for the Company's sole benefit and may be waived by it before expiration | The Company may extend or amend either Offer and may terminate an Offer under the stated circumstances | The Company will not make the Offer or accept tenders in jurisdictions where doing so would violate applicable law, subject to its stated compliance efforts

security_description: Options to purchase RxSight, Inc. common stock, $0.001 par value, granted under the 2021 Equity Incentive Plan, whether vested or unvested
event_status_details: The one-time voluntary stock option exchange offer commenced on 8/10/2026.
offer_price: Named executive officers: new options at option-to-option ratios of 1.00 to 1 for eligible options with exercise prices of $10.00-$11.99, 1.15 to 1 for $12.00-$14.99, 1.33 to 1 for $15.00-$29.99, and 1.55 to 1 for $30.00 or more; non-executive employees: RSUs at option-to-RSU ratios of 1.55 to 1 for $6.00-$8.99, 1.70 to 1 for $9.00-$11.99, 2.20 to 1 for $12.00-$29.99, and 2.70 to 1 for $30.00 or more
offer_price_basis: Shares subject to each eligible RxSight, Inc. common stock option grant exchanged for one share subject to a new option, or for one RSU, as applicable
offer_price_qualifications: New options have a 7-year term and an exercise price payable to RxSight upon exercise; RSUs require no cash payment to receive the RSUs or shares upon vesting | New awards have a different vesting schedule and are unvested when granted | Fractional shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share | Tax withholding obligations are satisfied as specified in the applicable award agreement
withdrawal_terms: If the offer is extended, elections may be withdrawn until the extended expiration date | If properly tendered options have not been accepted by 10/6/2026 9:00 PM Pacific Time, they may be withdrawn thereafter before acceptance
settlement_terms: Acceptance: promptly following expiration, subject to the offer's terms and conditions | Exchanged options: expected to be canceled on 9/5/2026 | New awards: expected to be granted on 9/5/2026, the same U.S. calendar day as cancellation; the grant date will be delayed if the offer is extended | Award agreements: sent promptly after expiration | Shares: received if and when new awards vest; vested options must be exercised and the exercise price paid
tendering_conditions: Eligible participants are RxSight employees, including named executive officers, located in the United States at the start of the offer who remain employees through expiration and the new award grant date; non-employee directors and employees outside the United States are excluded | Eligible options must have been granted under the 2021 Equity Incentive Plan, have an exercise price of at least $6.00 ($10.00 for named executive officers) and at least the common stock closing price on the expiration date, and remain outstanding and unexercised through expiration | Submit a properly completed election through www.myoptionexchange.com by 9/4/2026 9:00 PM Pacific Time, unless extended; acknowledge the offer terms and submit the election on the website | Each selected grant must be tendered in its entirety, including the entire remaining unexercised portion of a partially exercised grant; partial tenders of a grant are not accepted | Elections by email, facsimile, hand delivery, interoffice mail, U.S. mail or similar post, or Federal Express or similar delivery service are not permitted | RxSight may reject tenders it determines are improperly formed or unlawful to accept; a tender is not properly made until defects or irregularities are cured or waived
available_options: Eligible employees may exchange one or more entire eligible option grants without exchanging all eligible grants, or elect not to exchange; named executive officers receive new options and other eligible employees receive RSUs at the applicable exercise-price-based exchange ratios
default_option: If an employee does nothing, the employee does not participate and retains existing options under their current terms | An eligible option not selected for exchange on the offer website defaults to “Do Not Exchange” | If no properly completed election is received before expiration, the employee is treated as rejecting the offer
financial_terms: The Schedule TO states that eligible options cover up to 4083693 common shares; Section 9 of the Offer to Exchange states 4083293 shares, so the precise total is unresolved | If all eligible options are tendered and accepted, approximately 1643328 shares would be covered by new options and approximately 912989 shares by RSUs | Canceled options' underlying shares return to the 2021 Plan pool | RxSight will not pay broker, dealer or other-person commissions for soliciting exchanges
conditions_restrictions: RxSight may terminate the offer or postpone acceptance and cancellation if specified events occur before expiration, including offer-related litigation or legal restraints; specified financial-market, banking, credit or war events; a third-party tender offer or business-combination proposal or specified ownership changes; accounting changes requiring unanticipated compensation expense; a material adverse change in its business or financial condition; or material impairment of the offer's contemplated benefits | RxSight may waive conditions before expiration in its discretion, uniformly for eligible employees | It may extend the offer, and may amend it before expiration, including changing consideration or the number of options sought, subject to applicable law | New awards will not be granted if prohibited by applicable law or regulation | The offer will not be made to, and options will not be accepted from, holders in a jurisdiction where RxSight cannot comply with applicable law after a good-faith effort

tendering_conditions: Offer made to all Shareholders | Complete and sign a Letter of Transmittal and deliver it by mail or otherwise to FT Vest Total Return Income Fund: Series B3, c/o UMB Fund Services, Inc., 235 W. available_options: Shareholders may tender all or some of their Shares | For a partial tender, holders may specify a number of Class A or Class I Shares or a dollar amount

conditions_restrictions: The Board may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date, amend the Offer, postpone acceptance or cancel the Offer | Cancellation, amendment or postponement may occur if orderly portfolio liquidation consistent with investment objectives and policies is unavailable; specified legal action, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspension, war or calamity, material net asset value decrease, or another materially adverse event or condition occurs; the Board determines purchase is not in the Fund’s best interest; or the SEC permits another period for Shareholder protection | No material financing conditions | Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, where unlawful

offer_price: Net asset value of the tendered Shares as of the Valuation Date, less any early repurchase fee
offer_price_basis: per Class A, Class D or Class I Share of beneficial interest
offer_price_qualifications: 2.00% early repurchase fee for Shares repurchased before the day immediately preceding the one-year anniversary of purchase; the Fund may waive the fee if the Board determines that doing so is in the Fund’s best interests | Value is reduced by applicable fees, required tax withholding and other liabilities attributable to the repurchased Shares | The Valuation Date may change if the Offer is extended, and the value is subject to adjustment based on the annual audit | No interest on the purchase amount
withdrawal_terms: If the Fund has not accepted a Shareholder’s tender on or prior to 3/31/2026, the Shareholder may also withdraw after that date
settlement_terms: Acceptance: when the Fund gives the tendering Shareholder written notice of its election to purchase | Initial cash payment: at least 90% of the estimated aggregate value of repurchased Shares, within 65 days after the Initial Notice Due Date | Final payment: the excess, if any, of the audited aggregate value over the Initial Payment, no later than 5 business days after completion of the annual audit | If the Shareholder retains at least 5% of the aggregate value of its Shares after repurchase, the Final Payment is due on or before the 60th day after the Valuation Date, subject to subsequent audit-based account adjustments
proration_terms: If Shares exceeding 5.00% of the Fund’s net assets are duly tendered and not withdrawn before the Notice Due Date, the Fund may, in its sole discretion, accept additional Shares permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(1)(ii), extend the Offer and increase the amount offered for repurchase, or accept timely tendered Shares for payment pro rata based on their aggregate net asset value
tendering_conditions: All Shareholders may tender all or some of their Shares | A completed and signed Letter of Transmittal must be received by SS&C GIDS, Inc. before 4:00 PM Eastern Time on 3/6/2026, or by a later Notice Due Date if extended; submission may be by mail or delivery to FS MVP Private Markets Fund, c/o SS&C GIDS, Inc., PO Box 219045, Kansas City, Missouri 64105-1307, by fax to (833) 949-2830, or by secured email to mvpprivate.ai@sscinc.com | Separate forms are required when tendering more than one Share class | For Shares registered in a custodian’s name, the custodian must sign the form | A partial tender is subject to a remaining minimum account balance of $100000 in Class I Shares or $25000 in Class A or Class D Shares, unless the Board waives the requirement | The Fund may reject improperly formed or unlawful tenders and determine the time allowed to cure defects
available_options: Shareholders may tender all or some of their Shares; a partial tender may specify a dollar amount or number of Shares, subject to the applicable minimum remaining account balance
default_option: If no remittance option is selected, proceeds for non-custodial accounts are sent to the owners’ address of record and proceeds for custodial accounts are sent to the custodian of record | If bank account information is not on record for a selected bank-account payment, payment is sent to the applicable address of record
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to approximately 5.00% of its net assets, or approximately $80749609.27 or 5936088.159 Shares outstanding as of 12/31/2025 | Payment will be entirely in cash, funded from cash on hand, proceeds from sales of portfolio holdings or borrowings
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date; it may amend the Offer or postpone acceptance | The Fund may cancel, amend or postpone the Offer if it cannot liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with its objectives and policies; if specified legal actions, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspensions, hostilities, a material NAV decrease or another materially adverse event occurs; if the Board determines purchase is not in the Fund’s best interests; or during periods permitted by SEC order | There are no material financing conditions | The Offer excludes jurisdictions where it or acceptance of tenders would not comply with applicable law

offer_price: 10 shares of common stock for each Bridge Placement Agent Warrant

withdrawal_terms: If tendered Shares have not been accepted by the Fund, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 4/10/2026

proration_terms: If more than 1455615 Shares are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund will accept Shares tendered on or before the Expiration Date on a pro rata basis based on the number of tendered Shares, with priority for repurchase requests in the case of the death or disability of a shareholder | The Fund reserves the right in its sole discretion to purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of its outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer

available_options: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares | For a partial tender, a Shareholder may elect to change the request to a full repurchase if the requested amount would otherwise need to be reduced to maintain the minimum account balance
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 1455615 Shares, approximately 5% of outstanding Shares as of December 31, 2025 | Purchase proceeds are expected to come from cash on hand, including cash received from investments, borrowings and/or proceeds from sales of portfolio holdings | The Fund does not expect to impose repurchase charges other than any applicable early repurchase deduction

event_status_details: The Offer began on February 26, 2026 and was scheduled to expire on March 27, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value per Unit calculated as of June 30, 2026, less any applicable Early Repurchase Fee
offer_price_basis: per Unit of limited liability company interest
offer_price_qualifications: A 5% Early Repurchase Fee, payable to the Fund, applies to Units held for less than one year as of the Repurchase Date | Payment may be made through non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory notes | The Board may pay proceeds, in whole or in part, in underlying securities of equivalent value
withdrawal_terms: After the Offer Acceptance Deadline, Members may withdraw tendered Units as permitted by the Fund in its discretion at any time prior to the Repurchase Date or as otherwise permitted by law.
settlement_terms: Acceptance: when the Fund gives written notice to tendering Members of its election to purchase their Units | For purchases of less than 95% of a Member’s Units: a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable note entitles the Member to 100% of unaudited net asset value, less any Early Repurchase Fee, payable upon the later of 30 calendar days after the Repurchase Date or, if applicable, 10 business days after the Fund receives at least 90% of amounts withdrawn or redeemed from Underlying Funds to fund the repurchase | For purchases of 95% or more: an initial payment of 95% of estimated unaudited net asset value, less the allocable fee, in cash or by note, on or before the Payment Date; a note for up to the remaining 5%, subject to adjustment and payment following the later of 120 calendar days after the Repurchase Date or a longer period the Board deems necessary | Payments may be further delayed by unusual delays in receiving payments from Underlying Funds; the Board may pay earlier or use underlying securities
proration_terms: If Members tender more than 20% of the unaudited net asset value of Units outstanding as of the Offer Acceptance Deadline, the Board may accept additional Units permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(3), increase the Units offered for purchase by up to 2%, extend and increase the Offer, or accept tendered Units for payment on a pro rata basis based on their aggregate net asset value | Unaccepted Units are not automatically carried forward or given priority in a future offer
tendering_conditions: All Members may tender | Complete and sign a Request to Tender Form and deliver it to the Bank of New York Mellon by mail, overnight delivery or email so that it is received by 3/27/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Daylight Time | Members whose Letter of Transmittal directs delivery through an authorized financial consultant, financial advisor or placement agent must follow those instructions | Late responses are void | For a partial tender, the remaining Units must generally have aggregate net asset value of at least $25,000; the Fund may reduce the amount repurchased to maintain that minimum | The Fund determines tender validity and may reject defective tenders or waive defects
available_options: Members may tender all or a portion of their Units, subject to generally maintaining at least $25,000 in aggregate net asset value of Units after a partial repurchase
default_option: A Member who does not wish to tender Units need take no action | Offer Acceptances received after the deadline are void | A tender with unwaived defects is not deemed made until the defects are cured
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to approximately 20% of its outstanding Units | Transaction valuation: $1253882161, based on 20% of the Fund’s net asset value as of January 31, 2026 | The Fund may use cash, liquidate holdings in Underlying Funds or decide to borrow to pay repurchase proceeds; no borrowing had been determined | Expected Offer expenses: approximately $225000, including printing, mailing, filing fees and legal costs
conditions_restrictions: No material financing conditions | The Fund may suspend or postpone the Offer in limited circumstances only by a majority Board vote, including a majority of Independent Directors, including during an emergency, periods permitted by SEC order, or other unusual circumstances the Board determines warrant suspension or postponement in the interests of the Fund or Members | The Fund may extend, amend or cancel the Offer and may adjust the Repurchase Date to correspond with an extension | The Fund reserves the right to reject unlawful tenders and waive Offer conditions or tender defects | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, where the Offer or acceptance would not comply with applicable law

offer_price: Net asset value per Unit as of June 30, 2026, less any applicable Early Repurchase Fee; or, when available and elected, Master Fund Units equal in value to the Units repurchased, based on their relative net asset value as of June 30, 2026
offer_price_basis: per unit of limited liability company interest of Ironwood Multi-Strategy Fund LLC
offer_price_qualifications: A 5% Early Repurchase Fee applies to Units held for less than one year as of the Repurchase Date | The fee is waived for Units exchanged for Master Fund Units, when such exchanges are available subject to the discretion of the Feeder Fund and the Master Fund | Cash proceeds may be paid through non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory notes | For cash tenders of 95% or more of a Member’s Units, an initial payment of 95% of estimated unaudited net asset value, less the allocable fee, is subject to a subsequent payment based on final net asset value | Payments may be subject to withholding | In unusual circumstances, proceeds for Units tendered for cash may be paid in underlying securities
withdrawal_terms: After the Offer Acceptance Deadline, Members may withdraw tendered Units as permitted by the Feeder Fund in its discretion at any time prior to the Repurchase Date or as otherwise permitted by law.
settlement_terms: Acceptance: when the Feeder Fund gives written notice to tendering Members of its election to purchase their Units | For cash tenders of less than 95% of a Member’s Units, a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable note entitles the Member to 100% of unaudited net asset value, less the applicable fee, payable upon the later of 30 calendar days after the Repurchase Date or, if specified Underlying Fund withdrawals or redemptions fund the repurchase, 10 business days after the Master Fund receives at least 90% of those proceeds | For cash tenders of 95% or more, cash or a note for an initial 95% of estimated unaudited net asset value, less the allocable fee, is payable on or before that Payment Date; a note for up to the remaining 5% is adjusted as needed and paid following the later of 120 calendar days after the Repurchase Date or a longer period the Board deems necessary | Payments may be delayed by unusual delays in Underlying Fund payments; the Board may pay earlier or, in unusual circumstances, distribute underlying securities for cash tenders | When available and approved by both funds, exchange consideration is Master Fund Units of equal value
proration_terms: If Master Fund members tender more than 20% of the unaudited net asset value of Master Fund Units outstanding as of the Offer Acceptance Deadline, the Master Fund may, in its Board’s sole and absolute discretion, accept additional Units permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(3), increase the amount offered by up to 2%, extend and increase its offer, or accept tendered Master Fund Units pro rata based on their aggregate net asset value | The Feeder Fund expects corresponding adjustments to its Offer | Unaccepted Units receive no automatic carryforward or priority in a future offer
tendering_conditions: All Feeder Fund Members are eligible | A Member tendering some but not all Units must generally retain Units with aggregate net asset value of at least $25000; the Feeder Fund may reduce the repurchase amount to preserve that minimum | A completed, signed Request to Tender Form must be received by the Bank of New York Mellon by 3/27/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Daylight Time, by mail, overnight delivery or e-mail; certain Members must deliver it through their authorized financial consultant, financial advisor or placement agent | Responses received after the deadline are void | The Feeder Fund determines validity, form, eligibility and acceptance, may reject improperly tendered Units, and may waive defects or irregularities
available_options: Tender all or part of the Member’s Units, subject to the minimum remaining holding for partial tenders | Tender for cash or, at the Member’s election and subject to the discretion of the Feeder Fund and the Master Fund, exchange Units for Master Fund Units of equal value based on relative net asset values as of the Repurchase Date
financial_terms: The Offer is limited by the Master Fund Offer for up to approximately 20% of outstanding Master Fund Units; the Feeder Fund expects to be able to repurchase approximately 20% to 38.7% of its outstanding Units, depending on Master Fund tenders | The stated aggregate maximum value of Feeder Fund Units being purchased is $650074262, based on 20% of its January 31, 2026 net asset value | Payment for cash tenders may require the Master Fund to liquidate Underlying Fund holdings, maintain cash or borrow money; no borrowing decision has been made | The Feeder Fund expects approximately $82000 of Offer expenses, including printing, mailing and legal costs
conditions_restrictions: The Offer is subject to its stated conditions and the limit arising from the Master Fund Offer | The Feeder Fund may suspend or postpone the Offer in limited circumstances only by a majority Board vote, including a majority of Independent Directors, for a specified emergency, SEC-permitted periods, or other unusual circumstances determined to be in the stated interests of the funds or their members | The Feeder Fund reserves the right to waive Offer conditions or tender defects and may extend, amend or cancel the Offer; it may adjust the Repurchase Date to correspond with an extension | There are no material conditions to financing | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, where doing so would violate applicable jurisdictional law

settlement_terms: Acceptance of tendered Shares forms a binding agreement, and accepted holders receive an Acceptance Letter | A non-interest-bearing, non-transferable and non-negotiable promissory note is issued promptly following expiration of the Offer and held by the Transfer Agent | Cash payment is made promptly after determination of net asset value as of March 31, 2026; unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay, payment under the note is made on or before 30 days after the Valuation Date

event_status_details: The tender offer period began March 2, 2026 and was scheduled to end March 31, 2026.
offer_price: Estimated net asset value as of the close of business on March 31, 2026, if the Offer expires on March 31, 2026; if the tender period is extended, estimated net asset value determined approximately one month after the tender offer actually expires
offer_price_basis: Per limited liability company Interest or portion thereof in Aetos Distressed Investment Strategies Fund, LLC
offer_price_qualifications: Partial tenders: cash equal to 100% of estimated unaudited net asset value of Interests tendered and accepted | Full tenders: initial cash payment equal to 95% of estimated unaudited value of Interests tendered and accepted; balance determined and paid promptly after completion of the Fund's annual audit
withdrawal_terms: If Interests have not been accepted by the Fund, withdrawal is permitted at any time after 3/31/2026
settlement_terms: The Fund accepts Interests when it gives oral or written notice to the tendering investor of its election to purchase | Payments will be made by April 30, 2026, or, if the Fund requests withdrawals of capital from Portfolio Funds to fund the purchase, within ten business days after receiving at least 95% of the aggregate amount withdrawn | Partial tenders receive 100% of estimated unaudited net asset value in cash; full tenders initially receive 95%, with the balance determined and paid promptly after the annual audit | Cash payments will be wired to a designated account or sent to the investor's mailing address in the Fund's records, unless the investor advises the Fund in writing of a change of address
proration_terms: If more than $2,000,000 of Interests are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund may, in its sole discretion, accept additional Interests permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(1)(ii), extend the Offer and increase the amount offered for purchase, or accept timely tendered Interests for payment pro rata based on the aggregate estimated net asset value of tendered Interests
tendering_conditions: Investors may tender all or part of their Interests | Send or deliver a completed and executed Letter of Transmittal, for which the last page suffices, to Aetos Alternatives Management, LP, 875 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10022, Attention: Valerie Romeo, or fax it to 212-201-2525, Attention: Valerie Romeo | The Investment Adviser must receive it by the Expiration Date; investors who fax it must promptly send or deliver the original | A partial tender may specify a dollar value or percentage of net asset value | The Fund determines tender validity, form, eligibility and acceptance; defects or irregularities must be cured within the time the Fund determines unless waived
available_options: Tender the entire Interest or a portion; for a partial tender, specify a dollar value or percentage of net asset value | Direct tender proceeds to Aetos Alternatives Management, LP, to the investor, or partly to each, or direct payment to the investor less specified fees payable to Aetos
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to $2,000,000 of Interests, unless it elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources: cash on hand; proceeds of the sale of and/or delivery of Fund securities and portfolio assets; and/or possible borrowings | No borrowing facilities have been entered into to date
conditions_restrictions: The Offer is not subject to a financing condition | The Fund may extend, amend or cancel the Offer or postpone acceptance of Interests | Cancellation, amendment or postponement may occur if orderly portfolio liquidation consistent with the Fund's objectives and policies is not possible; specified legal, banking, credit, trading, war or calamity events occur; estimated net asset value materially decreases; another event would materially adversely affect the Fund or its investors; or the independent Managers determine purchase is not in the Fund's best interest | The Offer will not be made, nor tenders accepted, in jurisdictions where doing so would not comply with securities or Blue Sky laws

security_description: Zoomcar Holdings, Inc. privately issued Series A common stock purchase warrants (Series A Warrants); warrant par value N/A
event_status_details: Amendment No. 3 updates the number of Common Warrants as of the record date; the amended Offer to Exchange is dated March 2, 2026
offer_price: 10 shares of common stock for each Series A Warrant
offer_price_basis: per Series A Warrant
offer_price_qualifications: No scrip or fractional shares will be issued; any fractional shares otherwise issuable will be aggregated by holder and rounded down to the nearest whole share | Shares are expected to be restricted securities and will bear an appropriate legend | Receipt of shares requires a lock-up agreement: 50% restricted for 12 months after the Expiration Date and 50% for 18 months after the Expiration Date, subject to customary exceptions
withdrawal_terms: Holders may also withdraw tendered Eligible Warrants if the Company has not accepted them for exchange within 40 business days from commencement of the Offer
settlement_terms: Upon expiration of the Offer, the Company expects to accept properly tendered Eligible Warrants that have not been validly withdrawn and issue common shares in exchange, subject to the Offer conditions and participating holders' execution and delivery of the Lock-Up Agreement
tendering_conditions: Only eligible privately issued Series A Warrants may be tendered | Holders must complete, sign and deliver the applicable Letter of Transmittal and Consent and any other required documents to the Exchange Agent by 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on the Expiration Date | A fiduciary or representative signer must indicate their full title and provide evidence of authority | Holders may tender all or any portion of their Series A Warrants | An incomplete, incorrectly completed or late Letter of Transmittal and Consent is treated as rejection of the Offer for those warrants | Holders whose required documents cannot be delivered before expiration may tender if they comply with the procedures described in Section 2
available_options: Holders may tender all or any portion of their Series A Warrants at 10 shares of common stock per Series A Warrant
default_option: A holder who does not submit a properly completed Letter of Transmittal and Consent before the Expiration Date, or submits an incomplete or incorrectly completed one, is considered to have rejected the Offer for those Series A Warrants
financial_terms: As of January 22, 2026, 3312437 Series A Warrants were outstanding and eligible | No cash consideration is paid and there is no source of funds to disclose | The Company will use funds on hand for incidental expenses and existing funds for Offer expenses | The Exchange Agent will not be compensated for soliciting tenders, and its compensation will not depend on the number of warrants tendered or exchanged
conditions_restrictions: The Company's stockholders must approve the Authorized Share Increase, and the related certificate amendment must be filed and effective before any warrants are accepted or shares issued | No applicable action, event, law or order may challenge the Offer or reasonably be expected to prohibit, prevent, restrict or delay it, or otherwise materially adversely affect it | The Offer with respect to Series A Warrants may be conditioned upon obtaining requisite holder consents for amendments or supplements necessary to facilitate the exchange | Participating holders must execute and deliver the Lock-Up Agreement before receiving shares | The Company may extend, amend or terminate the Offer as described; it may terminate if conditions are not satisfied before expiration | The Offer is not made to, and tenders will not be accepted from or on behalf of, holders residing in a U.S. state where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable law

event_status_details: The tender offer period began March 26, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value as of the close of business on the Valuation Date
offer_price_basis: per limited partnership interest in SEI Structured Credit Fund, LP, or portion thereof
offer_price_qualifications: If the Offer is extended, the Fund may adjust the Valuation Date | For an entire Interest, the initial payment is 90% of unaudited net asset value estimated as of the Valuation Date; a contingent payment, if any, reflects the difference from the value as of that date, subject to applicable subsequent revisions | For a partial Interest, payment is its unaudited net asset value as of the Valuation Date | Payments may be in cash and/or securities
settlement_terms: Acceptance occurs when the Fund gives written notice of its election to purchase | Entire Interest: initial payment of 90% of estimated unaudited net asset value in cash and/or securities within 35 days after the Valuation Date, unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay; contingent payment, if any, promptly after the next annual audit | Partial Interest: payment of unaudited net asset value within 35 days after the Valuation Date | Cash payments are wired to the investor's designated account
proration_terms: If more than $86690000 in Interests are duly tendered and not withdrawn, the Fund may accept Interests tendered on or before the Expiration Date for payment on a pro rata basis based on the aggregate value of tendered Interests, rather than purchase additional Interests or extend and increase the Offer | If proration would leave an investor who tendered all Interests below the applicable minimum account balance, the Fund may repurchase that investor's remaining Interests

available_options: Tender the entire Interest | Tender a portion expressed as a specific dollar value, subject to the $250000 minimum account balance | Tender the entire amount above the required minimum account balance
financial_terms: Offer to purchase up to $86690000 in Interests, unless the Fund elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources: cash on hand, proceeds from selling portfolio securities and assets, and/or possible borrowings | The Fund presently does not intend to borrow to fund payments
conditions_restrictions: There are no material financing conditions or alternative financing plans | The Fund may extend, amend or cancel the Offer, suspend it, or postpone acceptance | Grounds for cancellation, suspension, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate assets in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal, banking, credit, trading, calamity or material adverse events; a material decrease in net asset value; or a Board determination that purchase is not in the Fund's best interest | The conditions are for the Fund's sole benefit and may be waived by the Fund in whole or in part on or before the Expiration Date | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, where doing so would violate applicable jurisdictional law

available_options: Investors may tender all or a portion of their Shares | Partial tenders are subject to maintaining a minimum $10,000 account balance
financial_terms: The Fund will purchase up to $32,600,000 of Shares, unless it elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources are cash on hand, withdrawals of capital from Investment Funds, proceeds from sales of securities and portfolio assets, or possibly borrowings | No persons have been employed, retained or are to be compensated by the Fund to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the Offer
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date | The Fund may amend the Offer or postpone acceptance of tendered Shares | The Fund may cancel or suspend the Offer if it cannot liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with its objectives and policies; if the Board judges that specified legal, banking, credit, trading, calamity, net asset value or other materially adverse circumstances exist; or if the Board determines purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | There are no material conditions to financing | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, in jurisdictions where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable law

event_status_details: Tender offer period began April 28, 2026
offer_price: Net asset value of tendered Units as of the Valuation Date, less any Early Repurchase Fee
offer_price_basis: per Unit of limited liability company interests, including Class A, Class S, Class I and Class M Units

proration_terms: If tendered and unwithdrawn Units exceed approximately 5.00% of the Fund’s net assets, the Fund may accept additional Units permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(1)(ii), extend and increase the offer amount, or accept timely tendered and unwithdrawn Units pro rata based on their aggregate net asset value
tendering_conditions: All Members are eligible | Tender all or part of Units by submitting a completed, signed Letter of Transmittal to State Street Bank and Trust Company by mail, delivery or email, received by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on May 26, 2026, or a later Notice Due Date if extended | Clients of certain financial advisers may instead sign and return a customized tender offer form to their adviser for submission by the same deadline; they should not also submit a Letter of Transmittal | Defective or irregular tenders are not deemed made until cured or waived; the Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form
available_options: Members may tender all or part of their Units | For a partial tender, the Board of Managers may reduce the repurchase amount or repurchase the remaining Units if the retained Class A or Class S Units would have net asset value below $25000, or retained Class I or Class M Units below $100000
financial_terms: Up to approximately 5.00% of the Fund’s net assets, approximately $12900000 or 6997121 outstanding Units as of February 28, 2026 | Sources: cash on hand, proceeds from securities sales, withdrawal proceeds from investment funds, or borrowings
conditions_restrictions: The Board of Managers may extend the offer and adjust the Valuation Date, amend the offer, postpone acceptance or cancel it | The Fund may cancel, amend or postpone acceptance if orderly portfolio liquidation is unavailable; specified legal, banking, credit, trading, hostilities, net asset value or other material adverse circumstances arise; the Board determines a purchase is not in the Fund’s best interest; or the SEC permits another protective period | No material financing conditions | The offer is not made and tenders will not be accepted where doing so would violate applicable law

financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 2444490 Shares, approximately 5% of Shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 | Expected funding sources include cash on hand, borrowings and proceeds from the sale of investments | Other than an applicable early repurchase deduction, the Fund does not expect to impose charges on repurchases
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date; it may also cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance before accepting tendered Shares | Stated grounds include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal proceedings, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspensions, hostilities or calamities, a material decrease in estimated NAV, or another material adverse event or condition; or an Independent Trustee determination that the purchase is not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund reserves the right to waive Offer conditions or tender defects | The Offer will not be made, and tenders will not be accepted, where doing so would not comply with applicable securities or Blue Sky laws

security_description: Antares Strategic Credit Fund common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share
event_status_details: The tender offer period began May 14, 2026 and was scheduled to end June 11, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value per Share as of June 30, 2026 or a later date determined by the Fund if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per common share of beneficial interest
offer_price_qualifications: A 5% early repurchase deduction applies to tendered and purchased Shares for which the 12-month Non-Tender Period has expired but which were issued after January 1, 2025, except Shares issued pursuant to the Fund’s distribution reinvestment plan | The Fund may waive the deduction in the case of a shareholder’s death, divorce or qualified disability | The note issued upon acceptance is non-interest-bearing and non-transferable
withdrawal_terms: If tendered Shares have not been accepted by the Fund, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 7/13/2026
settlement_terms: The Fund accepts tendered Shares when it gives written notice to the tendering Shareholder of its election to purchase them | An accepted Shareholder receives a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note held by the Transfer Agent | Cash payment will be made promptly after the relevant NAV per Share is finalized; the form of note provides for a single installment on or before 35 calendar days after the Valuation Date, unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay
proration_terms: If more than 5951674 Shares are tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund will accept Shares tendered on or before expiration on a pro rata basis according to the number tendered, with priority for repurchase requests in the case of a shareholder’s death or disability | The Fund may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must complete and sign the Letter of Transmittal in accordance with its instructions; the specified agent must receive it by 6/11/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Time, unless the Offer is extended | Submission may be by mail to Antares Strategic Credit Fund, c/o U.S. Bancorp Fund Services, LLC, 615 East Michigan St., Milwaukee, WI 53202, or by email to tenders@usbank.com; certain Shareholders may be required to deliver the Letter of Transmittal to their Financial Advisor instead | For joint accounts, each joint holder must sign; requests for an entity should include evidence of the signer’s authority | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful; defects must be cured within the time the Fund determines unless waived
available_options: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares | For a partial repurchase that would reduce the account below the required minimum balance, a holder may elect to change the request to a full repurchase rather than have the repurchase amount reduced
default_option: If a requested partial repurchase would reduce the account below the required minimum balance, the Fund may reduce the amount repurchased to maintain that balance unless the holder elects a full repurchase
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 5951674 Shares, approximately 7.5% of Shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025 | The stated maximum transaction valuation is $151291553.08 | Purchase proceeds are expected to come from cash on hand, including cash received from investments in the Fund, borrowings and/or proceeds from sales of portfolio holdings | Other than any applicable early repurchase deduction, the Fund does not expect to impose charges on repurchases
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date to correspond to an extension | Up to and including acceptance of tenders, the Fund may cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance | Grounds stated for cancellation, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal proceedings, banking, credit or trading disruptions, war or calamity, a material decrease in estimated NAV, or another event materially adverse to the Fund or its Shareholders; or a determination by the Independent Trustees that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund may waive any Offer condition or tender defect for particular Shares or Shareholders | The Offer will not be made, and tenders will not be accepted, where doing so would violate applicable securities or Blue Sky laws

available_options: A Shareholder may tender all or a portion of its Shares | A holder tendering only part generally must maintain a $10000 account balance, subject to Board waiver
financial_terms: Up to approximately 5.00% of the Fund’s net assets as of March 31, 2026, unless the Fund elects to repurchase a greater amount | Sources of payment: cash on hand, proceeds from sales of Fund securities, withdrawals from redeemable investment funds, or borrowings
conditions_restrictions: No material financing conditions | The Board may extend the Offer and set a later Valuation Date | The Fund may amend the Offer, postpone acceptance or cancel it under stated circumstances, including inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner, specified legal or market disruptions, a material decrease in net asset value, a material adverse effect, or a Board determination that repurchases are not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund reserves the right to exclude Shareholders in jurisdictions where it is asserted that the Offer cannot lawfully be made
