withdrawal_terms: If the Fund has not accepted the tendered Shares, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 6/30/2026
settlement_terms: The Fund accepts tendered Shares when it gives the Shareholder written notice of its election to purchase them | A non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note is issued promptly following expiration | The Fund will pay each Note in cash by check or wire transfer promptly after determining net asset value as of the Valuation Date | Unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay, payment under the Note will be made on or before 35 days after the Valuation Date
proration_terms: If more than 931582 Shares are tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund will accept Shares for payment pro rata based on the number tendered, with priority for repurchase requests in the case of a shareholder’s death or disability | The Fund may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer | Unaccepted Shares are not automatically carried forward or given priority in a future offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must complete and execute the Letter of Transmittal and have it received by the specified agent by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on June 18, 2026 | Shareholders directed to use the Transfer Agent may submit it by mail to John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund, c/o Ultimus Fund Solutions, LLC, 225 Pictoria Drive, Suite 450, Cincinnati, OH 45246, or by email to comvest@ultimusfundsolutions.com; others may be directed to submit it to their financial advisor | Shareholders may tender all or part of their Shares; a partial tender generally must leave a minimum account balance of $1500 as of the Valuation Date | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful, and may waive conditions or defects
available_options: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares | A Shareholder making a partial tender may elect a full repurchase if the requested amount would otherwise be reduced to maintain the minimum account balance | If a request would be reduced pro rata, a Shareholder may elect pro-rata processing or withdrawal of the entire request
default_option: If no pro-rata processing option is selected, the repurchase request will be processed pro rata if needed | If no cost-basis method is selected, FIFO applies
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 931582 Class I Shares, approximately 5% of Shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 | The Fund may purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer | Expected funding sources are cash on hand, including cash received from Fund investments; borrowings; and proceeds from the sale of other investments
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend, amend or cancel the Offer or postpone acceptance of tenders | Grounds stated for cancellation, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal actions, banking or credit restrictions, trading suspensions, calamities, a material decrease in estimated net asset value, or another materially adverse event or condition; or an Independent Trustee determination that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund’s best interest | The Fund may waive Offer conditions or tender defects in its sole discretion | The Offer excludes jurisdictions where making or accepting it would not comply with applicable laws

security_description: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund Class I, Class D, and Class S common shares of beneficial interest
event_status_details: The Offer began on May 29, 2026 and was scheduled to expire on June 29, 2026 unless extended.
offer_price: Net asset value per applicable class of Share as of June 30, 2026 or a later date determined by the Fund if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Class I, Class D, or Class S share of beneficial interest, as applicable
offer_price_qualifications: 2% early repurchase deduction for Shares with a tender valuation date within 12 months of their original issue date; the Fund may waive it for repurchases resulting from a Shareholder's death, qualifying disability or divorce | Payment is made through a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable, non-negotiable promissory note, followed by cash payment | U.S. tax backup withholding and withholding applicable to Non-U.S. Shareholders may apply
withdrawal_terms: Tendered Shares may be withdrawn at any time before the Expiration Date, including any extension period
settlement_terms: Acceptance of Shares forms a binding agreement, and accepted Shareholders receive an Acceptance Letter | A non-interest-bearing, non-transferable, non-negotiable promissory note is issued promptly following expiration of the Offer and held by the Transfer Agent | The Fund effects cash payment for each note promptly after determination of the applicable class's June 30, 2026 net asset value; the form of note states payment will be made on or before 30 days after the Valuation Date unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions result in a delay
proration_terms: If more than 3,013,484 Shares are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund will accept Shares tendered on or before the Expiration Date for payment pro rata based on the number of tendered Shares | There is no repurchase priority for requests in the case of a Shareholder's death or disability | The Fund may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders must complete and sign the Letter of Transmittal, following its instructions, and submit it to SS&C GIDS, Inc. by regular mail, overnight mail or e-mail, or to their financial advisor as directed in the Letter of Transmittal; the specified agent must receive it by 6/29/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Time | Shareholders who e-mail the Letter of Transmittal must promptly mail the original | Issuance of the payment note requires timely receipt of a properly completed Letter of Transmittal bearing original signatures and any required signature guarantees, plus any other required documents | Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Shares; a partial tender must leave a minimum account balance of $500 as of the Valuation Date, subject to the Fund's stated rights to purchase all Shares, reduce the number repurchased or waive the minimum | The Fund may reject tenders in inappropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful; defects must be cured within the time the Fund determines unless waived
available_options: Tender all or a portion of Shares | For a partial repurchase that would fall below the minimum account balance, elect to change the request to a full repurchase rather than have the requested amount reduced | If requests are prorated, elect to withdraw the entire request or have it honored pro rata | Select FIFO, LIFO or specific lots as the cost basis method
default_option: If no proration election is selected, the repurchase request will be processed pro rata if needed | If no cost basis method is selected, FIFO applies
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to 3,013,484 Shares, approximately 5% of Shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 | The Fund may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Shares without amending or extending the Offer | The actual total purchase cost is not determinable at this time; the expected sources are cash on hand, including cash received from investments in the Fund, borrowings and/or proceeds from the sale of portfolio holdings | Other than an applicable early repurchase deduction, the Fund does not expect to impose charges on repurchases | No persons have been employed, retained or are to be compensated by the Fund to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the Offer
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date, or cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance before accepting tenders | Grounds stated for cancellation, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal proceedings, banking or credit disruptions, market suspensions, war or calamity, a material decrease in estimated net asset value, or other events materially adverse to the Fund or Shareholders; or a determination by the independent trustees that purchasing Shares is not in the Fund's best interests | The Offer is not made to, and tenders will not be accepted from, Shareholders in jurisdictions where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable securities or Blue Sky laws

security_description: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company Class I, Class D and Class S common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share
event_status_details: The Offer began on June 1, 2026.
offer_price: Net asset value per share of the applicable class of Common Shares as of June 30, 2026 or a later date determined by the Company if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per Class I, Class D or Class S common share of beneficial interest, as applicable
offer_price_qualifications: Payment in cash | Tendered Common Shares accepted for repurchase are not entitled to dividends or distributions with a record date on or after acceptance | Applicable tax withholding may apply
withdrawal_terms: If the Company has not accepted the tendered Common Shares, withdrawal is also permitted on or after 7/29/2026
settlement_terms: Acceptance is effective as of the date specified in the Form of Acceptance delivered to the tendering Shareholder | Payment in cash promptly after net asset value per share of the applicable class as of the Valuation Date is finalized | Payment requires timely receipt of a properly completed and executed Letter of Transmittal and any other required documents | Unpurchased Common Shares will be returned or credited without expense promptly following expiration or termination
proration_terms: If more than 5.0% of Common Shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 (1862316 Common Shares) are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Company will accept timely tendered Common Shares for payment pro rata based on the number tendered | The Company may, in its sole discretion, purchase additional outstanding Common Shares representing up to 2.0% of outstanding Common Shares without amending or extending the Offer
tendering_conditions: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Common Shares | A properly completed and duly executed Letter of Transmittal, or an originally signed photocopy, and any other required documents must be received by the transfer agent before 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the Expiration Date by mail, delivery or email; emailed submissions must be followed promptly by the original or an originally signed photocopy by mail | Holders whose shares are registered with a broker, dealer, commercial bank, trust company or other nominee must contact that institution to effect the tender | Partial tenders must leave a minimum account balance of $10000 as of the Valuation Date; the Company may purchase all shares if the balance would fall below the minimum, may reduce the number repurchased to maintain it, and may waive the minimum account balance requirement | No alternative, conditional or contingent tenders will be accepted | The Company may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful, and may waive defects or irregularities
available_options: Shareholders may tender all or a portion of their Common Shares, subject to the $10000 minimum account balance for a partial tender
default_option: If no payment option is selected, proceeds for accepted Common Shares will be transmitted according to wire instructions on record with the transfer agent; qualified and certain broker-controlled accounts will be paid to the custodian or broker dealer of record, as applicable
financial_terms: Purchase of up to 5.0% of Common Shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026 (1862316 Common Shares), with discretion to purchase additional outstanding Common Shares representing up to 2.0% | Expected funding sources: cash on hand, including cash received from investments in the Company; borrowings; and/or proceeds from sale of portfolio holdings | The Company does not expect to impose charges on repurchases
conditions_restrictions: The Company may extend the Offer and adjust the Valuation Date, and may cancel or amend the Offer or postpone acceptance of tenders | Grounds for cancellation, amendment or postponement include inability to liquidate portfolio securities in an orderly manner consistent with investment objectives and policies; specified legal, banking, credit, market or national events; a material decrease in net asset value; another event or condition materially adverse to the Company or its Shareholders; or a determination by the Independent Trustees that purchasing shares is not in the Company's best interest | The Company may waive Offer conditions | The Offer is not made, and tenders will not be accepted, where doing so would violate applicable jurisdictional law

offer_price: Net asset value as of the close of business on September 30, 2026, or a later valuation date established if the Offer is extended
offer_price_basis: per limited partnership Interest or portion thereof
offer_price_qualifications: For an entire Interest, the initial payment is 90% of its estimated unaudited net asset value; a contingent payment equals the excess, if any, of its net asset value, as may be adjusted for subsequent investment-value revisions, over the initial payment | For a partial Interest, payment is its unaudited net asset value as of the Valuation Date | Payments may be made in cash and/or securities
settlement_terms: Acceptance occurs when the Fund gives written notice of its election to purchase | Entire Interest: initial payment of 90% of estimated unaudited net asset value in cash and/or securities within 35 days after the Valuation Date, unless changes in tax or other laws or regulations or unusual market conditions cause a delay; contingent payment, if any, promptly after the next annual audit | Partial Interest: payment of unaudited net asset value within 35 days after the Valuation Date | Cash payments are wired to the investor's designated account; securities payments require special arrangements
proration_terms: If more than $79,060,000 in Interests are duly tendered before expiration and not withdrawn, the Fund may accept Interests on a pro rata basis based on the aggregate value tendered, instead of or alongside accepting additional permitted Interests or extending and increasing the offer | If proration would leave an investor who tendered all Interests below the applicable minimum account balance, the Fund may repurchase that investor's remaining Interests
tendering_conditions: All Investors may tender | A completed and signed Letter of Transmittal must be received by the Fund, c/o SEI Private Trust Company, Attention: STAS Team, One Freedom Valley Drive, Oaks, PA 19456, or by fax at 610-676-1021, before 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on July 24, 2026, or a later expiration date if extended | An investor who faxes the letter must promptly send the original | A partial tender must leave at least $250,000 in the account as of the Valuation Date; the Fund may reduce the amount purchased to maintain that balance | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or whose acceptance or payment would be unlawful, and may waive defects; unwaived defects must be cured within the time the Fund determines
available_options: Tender the entire Interest | Tender a portion specified as a dollar value, subject to maintaining a $250,000 minimum account balance | Tender the portion exceeding the required minimum account balance
financial_terms: Offer to purchase up to $79,060,000 in Interests, unless the Fund elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources: cash on hand, including contemporaneous investments; proceeds from the sale of portfolio securities and assets; and/or possible borrowings | Filing fee: $10,918.19
conditions_restrictions: No material financing conditions or alternative financing plans | The Fund may extend, amend, cancel or suspend the Offer, or postpone acceptance | Grounds include inability to liquidate assets in an orderly manner consistent with investment policies; specified legal, banking, credit, trading, war or calamity events; a material decrease in net asset value; another materially adverse event or condition; or a Board determination that purchase is not in the Fund's best interest | The Fund may waive its conditions in whole or part on or before expiration | The Offer excludes jurisdictions where it or its acceptance would not comply with applicable law

financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to $17500000 of Shares, unless it elects to purchase a greater amount | Expected funding sources are cash on hand; withdrawals of capital from investment funds in which the Master Fund invests; proceeds from sales of securities and portfolio assets held by the Fund; or possible borrowings

bidder: Grosvenor Registered Multi-Strategy Master Fund, LLC
other_parties: GCM Grosvenor L.P. (investment adviser) | BNY Mellon Investment Servicing (U.S.) Inc. (administrator) | GRV Securities LLC (distributor)
security_description: Limited liability company interests, or portions thereof, in Grosvenor Registered Multi-Strategy Master Fund, LLC
event_status_details: Tender offer period began 6/26/2026
offer_price: Net asset value as of the Valuation Date
offer_price_basis: per limited liability company interest or portion thereof
offer_price_qualifications: Net asset value is determined after required allocations to the Investor's capital account | Consideration is a non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note providing an initial payment of at least 95% of unaudited net asset value and a contingent payment, if any, equal to the excess of net asset value, as it may be adjusted, over the initial payment | Payments may be made in cash and/or marketable securities; the purchase price will be paid entirely in cash except if the Board determines that distributing securities is necessary to avoid or mitigate an adverse effect on remaining Investors
withdrawal_terms: If the Fund has not accepted an Investor's tender on or before 8/21/2026, the Investor may withdraw the tender after 8/21/2026
settlement_terms: Acceptance occurs when the Fund gives written notice of its election to purchase | A non-interest-bearing, non-transferable promissory note entitles the Investor to an initial payment of at least 95% of unaudited net asset value within 35 calendar days after the Valuation Date, or within 10 business days after the Fund receives at least 90% of requested investment-fund withdrawals used to fund purchases | Initial payment is stated to be deposited or wired no later than 11/4/2026, unless the Valuation Date changes or the investment-fund withdrawal timing applies | A contingent payment, if any, is generally payable within 120 days after the Valuation Date | Cash proceeds are wire transferred to the Investor's designated account
proration_terms: If more than $32300000 of Interests are duly tendered and not withdrawn, the Fund may accept additional Interests permitted under Rule 13e-4(f)(1), extend the Offer and increase its purchase amount, or accept a portion of each Interest tendered by the Expiration Date on a pro rata basis based on the aggregate net asset value of tendered Interests
tendering_conditions: Offer made to all Investors | Unless otherwise instructed, complete and sign a Letter of Transmittal and submit it by mail to Grosvenor Funds, c/o BNY Mellon TA Alternative Investment RIC Funds, PO Box 534408, Pittsburgh, PA 15253-4408, or by email to grosvenordeinvservices@bnymellon.com, for receipt in good order by the Expiration Date | Investors instructed to use a financial intermediary must contact that intermediary to ensure proper documentation | Joint holders must each sign; entity requests must include evidence of signing authority | Partial tenders must specify a dollar value and are subject to a $25000 minimum remaining account balance; the Fund may reduce a purchase to maintain that balance | The Fund may reject tenders not in appropriate form or unlawful to accept and may waive conditions or defects; unwaived defects must be cured within the time the Fund determines
available_options: Investors may tender their entire Interest or a portion expressed as a specific dollar value | Partial tenders are subject to a $25000 minimum remaining account balance, and the Fund may reduce the amount purchased to maintain it
financial_terms: The Fund offers to purchase up to $32300000 of Interests | Expected funding sources are cash on hand, withdrawals of capital from investment funds, proceeds from sales of securities and portfolio assets, or possible borrowings
conditions_restrictions: The Fund may extend, amend, postpone acceptance, cancel or suspend the Offer | Cancellation or suspension may occur if orderly liquidation of portfolio securities consistent with investment objectives is not possible; specified legal, banking, credit, trading, calamity, net-asset-value or other materially adverse circumstances arise; or the Board determines purchasing Interests is not in the Fund's best interest | The Fund may reject tenders whose acceptance or payment counsel considers unlawful and may waive Offer conditions | There are no material conditions to financing | The Offer is not made to, and tenders will not be accepted from, Investors in jurisdictions where the Offer or its acceptance would not comply with applicable law

withdrawal_terms: A Shareholder whose written tender is not accepted by the Fund on or prior to August 31, 2026 will also have the right to withdraw its tender until that date
